docs.doc: A datum small enough to have a solution.
docs.name: Shape.Admissible

docs.doc: Every entry of `v` is at most `bound`, in a type with an order; the length is implicit.
docs.name: Shape.AllBelow
docs.type: {α : Type} → [LE α] → α → {n : Nat} → (Fin n → α) → Prop

docs.doc: A point with a positive first coordinate.
docs.name: Shape.Anchor

docs.doc: A path starting at `d`.
docs.name: Shape.Base

docs.doc: Both extents: `Anchor` is inherited along two paths, and its fields occur once.
docs.name: Shape.Both

docs.doc: `f` is bounded by `C`.
docs.name: Shape.Bounded

docs.doc: A concrete profile: a profile that vanishes from `N` on and has period `p` below `N`.
docs.name: Shape.Concrete
Shape.Concrete.periodic
docs.type: ∀ (self : Shape.Concrete) (n : Nat), n + self.p < self.N → self.f (n + self.p) = self.f n

docs.name: Shape.Concrete.support
docs.type: ∀ (self : Shape.Concrete) (n : Nat), self.N ≤ n → self.f n = 0

docs.doc: A digit with seventy values: more than a declaration's record lists of its equations.
docs.name: Shape.Digit

docs.doc: The value of a digit, by one equation for each of the seventy.
docs.name: Shape.Digit.val

docs.doc: `P` holds of every vector of `vs`.
docs.name: Shape.Every
docs.type: {n : Nat} → ((Fin n → Nat) → Prop) → List (Fin n → Nat) → Prop

docs.doc: A solution whose bound is at most `d + 10`.
docs.name: Shape.Good

docs.doc: The whole space has measure one.
docs.name: Shape.IsProbability
Shape.IsProbability.measure_univ
docs.type: ∀ {Ω : Type} {inst : Shape.MeasureData Ω} [self : Shape.IsProbability Ω], (Shape.MeasureData.measure fun x => True) = 1

docs.doc: The first `k` differences `f j` of `f` are bounded by `C` at every point of `S`.
docs.name: Shape.JetBound
docs.type: (Nat → Nat → Nat) → (Nat → Prop) → Nat → Nat → Prop

docs.doc: An anchor with a left extent.
docs.name: Shape.Left

docs.doc: A map from `G` to `H` over the scalars `K`.
docs.name: Shape.Linear
Shape.Linear.toFun
docs.type: {K G H : Type} → (G →[K] H) → G → H

docs.doc:
A measurable space with a measure: a family of measurable sets closed under complement, and
a measure of sets with the empty set of measure zero.
docs.name: Shape.MeasureData
Shape.MeasureData.measurable_compl
docs.type:
∀ {Ω : Type} [self : Shape.MeasureData Ω] (A : Ω → Prop),
  Shape.MeasureData.measurable A → Shape.MeasureData.measurable fun ω => ¬A ω

docs.name: Shape.MeasureData.measure_empty
docs.type: ∀ {Ω : Type} [self : Shape.MeasureData Ω], (Shape.MeasureData.measure fun x => False) = 0

docs.doc: `n` is a multiple of `m` with a quotient of at least `b`; `m` is written implicitly.
docs.name: Shape.MultipleAbove

docs.doc: A profile: a function with a bound on its values (the abstract definition).
docs.name: Shape.Profile

docs.doc: An anchor with a right extent at most its first coordinate.
docs.name: Shape.Right

docs.doc: A family bounded at every scale, for a datum `d` and a weight `w`.
docs.name: Shape.Scaled
Shape.Scaled.g
docs.type: {d : Nat} → {w : Nat → Nat} → Shape.Scaled d w → Nat → Nat

docs.name: Shape.Scaled.scale
docs.type: ∀ {d : Nat} {w : Nat → Nat} (self : Shape.Scaled d w) (k : Nat), ∃ m, ∀ (n : Nat), k ≤ n → self.g n ≤ m * w k + d

docs.doc: A scaled family that starts at `d`.
docs.name: Shape.ScaledStart
Shape.ScaledStart.start
docs.type: ∀ {d : Nat} {w : Nat → Nat} (self : Shape.ScaledStart d w), self.g 0 = d

docs.name: Shape.ScaledStart.toScaled
docs.type: {d : Nat} → {w : Nat → Nat} → Shape.ScaledStart d w → Shape.Scaled d w

docs.doc: A type with exactly one element, as a class with a law.
docs.name: Shape.Single
Shape.Single.uniq
docs.type: ∀ {α : Type} [self : Shape.Single α] (a : α), a = default

docs.doc:
A solution for the datum `d`: a path from `d` with a bound it never exceeds. Its fields are
data (`path`, `bound`) and properties (`start`, inherited from `Base`, and `le_bound`).
docs.name: Shape.Solution
Shape.Solution.le_bound
docs.type: ∀ {d : Nat} (self : Shape.Solution d) (n : Nat), self.path n ≤ self.bound

docs.doc: For every `x` there is `y` such that the bound holds for every `z`.
docs.name: Shape.alternating
docs.type: ∀ (x : Nat), ∃ y, ∀ (z : Nat), x + z ≤ y + z

docs.doc: An assumed existence of solutions: the solution belongs to the assumption.
docs.name: Shape.assumed
docs.type: (∀ (d : Nat), Shape.Admissible d → ∃ s, Shape.Good s) → ∃ s, Shape.Good s

docs.doc: A bound named like the definition's own bound variable.
docs.name: Shape.below_succ
docs.type: ∀ (i : Nat) (v : Fin 3 → Nat), Shape.AllBelow i v → Shape.AllBelow (i + 1) v

docs.doc: An assumed conjunction is one assumption with two parts.
docs.name: Shape.both
docs.type: ∀ (a b : Nat), a ≤ b ∧ b ≤ a → a = b

docs.doc: An object with both extents: its positivity is one field, inherited once.
docs.name: Shape.both_pos

docs.doc: The zero profile below `N`: a construction whose value is a concrete profile.
docs.name: Shape.build

docs.doc: The construction's recurrence, proved by a theorem of its own.
docs.name: Shape.build_rec

docs.doc:
An assumption that contains a conditional existence claim: its `y` belongs to the
assumption, and the statement's own `y` is the one it establishes.
docs.name: Shape.conditional
docs.type: ∀ (A : Nat → Prop) (B : Nat → Nat → Prop), (∀ (x : Nat), A x → ∃ y, B x y) → ∀ (a : Nat), A a → ∃ y, B a y

docs.doc: A partial application: `AllBelow 7` still awaits its vector.
docs.name: Shape.every_below
docs.type: ∀ (vs : List (Fin 2 → Nat)), Shape.Every (Shape.AllBelow 7) vs → Shape.Every (Shape.AllBelow 8) vs

docs.doc: The Fibonacci numbers, by recursion with three equations.
docs.name: Shape.fib

docs.doc: A bound of order `n + 5` gives one of order `n + 4`.
docs.name: Shape.jet_lower
docs.type: ∀ (f : Nat → Nat → Nat) (S : Nat → Prop) (n C : Nat), Shape.JetBound f S (n + 5) C → Shape.JetBound f S (n + 4) C

docs.doc: The last digit's value: the equation that applies is the seventieth.
docs.name: Shape.last_digit

docs.doc:
A digit with the last constructor index has the last value: a hypothesis on the `ctorIdx`
Lean generates for `Digit`, beside the project's `Digit.val`.
docs.name: Shape.last_index

docs.doc:
A statement shaped to exercise the reader's layout: objects with conditions of their own
(`E` with an instance, `j` with `1 ≤ j`), a condition shared by two objects (`j ≤ k`), an
alternating prefix (for all `x` there is `C` such that for all `n`), and a conjunction.
docs.name: Shape.layout
docs.type: ∀ (E : Type) [Inhabited E] (j : Nat), 1 ≤ j → ∀ (k : Nat), j ≤ k → ∀ (x : Nat), ∃ C, ∀ (n : Nat), x ≤ C ∧ n + x ≤ n + C

docs.doc: A statement about the module's private definitions.
docs.name: Shape.margin_half

docs.doc: Inside a negation, a solution and its properties are local to the negated claim.
docs.name: Shape.none_large

docs.doc:
One witness with two properties, whose type names its domain, codomain and scalars; each
assumption has a `Φ` of its own.
docs.name: Shape.one_map
docs.type:
∀ (G H : Type) (f : G → H) (A B : (G →[Nat] H) → Prop),
  (∀ (Φ : G →[Nat] H), A Φ) → (∀ (Φ : G →[Nat] H), B Φ) → ∃ Φ, A Φ ∧ B Φ

docs.doc: Overlapping patterns: the second equation holds when the first does not apply.
docs.name: Shape.pick

docs.doc: The overlapping case at a successor.
docs.name: Shape.pick_at

docs.doc: A positive number: positivity is part of the subtype.
docs.name: Shape.positive

docs.doc:
An existence established under a premise, an equivalence with an existence on one side, and
a witness in one alternative.
docs.name: Shape.premised

docs.doc: A measure space is supplied; that it is a probability space is an additional assumption.
docs.name: Shape.probability
docs.type: ∀ (Ω : Type) [inst : Shape.MeasureData Ω] [Shape.IsProbability Ω], (Shape.MeasureData.measure fun x => True) = 1

docs.doc: An established existence of solutions: the solution is produced by the statement.
docs.name: Shape.produced
docs.type: ∀ (d : Nat), Shape.Admissible d → ∃ s, Shape.Good s

docs.doc:
A scaled family at `d` and `w`: its inherited field keeps both parameters and its nested
quantifiers.
docs.name: Shape.scaled
docs.type: ∀ (d : Nat) (w : Nat → Nat) (s : Shape.ScaledStart d w), s.g 0 = d

docs.doc:
A negation, an alternative made of a "for every" and an implication whose conclusion is a
"there is", and an instance that supplies a proposition.
docs.name: Shape.shapes

docs.doc:
An input with one element: the class's law is part of what is given; `Subsingleton` says
there is at most one element, and the conclusion says there is one and only one.
docs.name: Shape.single
docs.type: ∀ (T : Type) [Shape.Single T], Subsingleton T ∧ ∃ x, ∀ (y : T), y = x

docs.doc: The number of steps down to zero, by recursion with a case condition.
docs.name: Shape.steps

docs.doc: Recursion at a successor.
docs.name: Shape.steps_pos

docs.doc: A supplied solution: its fields are part of what is given.
docs.name: Shape.supplied

docs.doc: Two solutions for the same datum start at the same point: each carries its own `start`.
docs.name: Shape.two_solutions
docs.type: ∀ (d : Nat) (s t : Shape.Solution d), s.path 0 = t.path 0

docs.doc: A helper accepting a concrete profile: its support is a condition on its input.
docs.name: Shape.vanishes
docs.type: ∀ (c : Shape.Concrete) (n : Nat), c.N ≤ n → c.f n = 0

docs.doc:
Two witnesses of the same name in sibling parts, each of its own type, and one witness
shared by the two parts of its body.
docs.name: Shape.witnesses
docs.type: ∀ (j : Nat), (∃ x, x j = j ∧ j ≤ x j) ∧ ∃ x, x = true

docs.doc: Half of a number, rounded down, by recursion: a private definition by equations.
docs.name: _private.Shape.Expand.0.Shape.half

docs.doc: A margin this module keeps to itself: a private definition.
docs.name: _private.Shape.Expand.0.Shape.margin
